decisions.reason: Imported result 8 cited the wrong Libedinsky paper and mixed unshifted theta modules with shifted B modules. Theorem 5.1 is in arXiv:0707.3603, not 1702.00039. Read sections 4.4–4.6 and the complete section 5 argument: normal-tensor triangularity proves independence and the graded Hom count supplies spanning. The source itself has a degree-sign inconsistency in Definition 5.4/Lemma 5.6; the ss computation gives map degrees 0,-2 and coefficient 1+q, so the repaired count uses q^{-deg/2}. Coefficient projections are only R^s-linear. The Definition section and all generator normalizations are unchanged.

The cited theorem does more than assert an abstract decomposition: its proof 3.1 defines exactly e=-mu_t^a kappa_s^a kappa_s mu_t, 4.1 identifies its small image using the left inverse -kappa_s mu_t, and 1.5/5.1/6.1 identify its complementary image by the 1-tensor map and degreewise dimension comparison. The example uses those identical coordinate maps, including the factor one-half in the contraction. Libedinsky sections 4.3–4.4 give the same projector; simultaneous reversal of both coordinate roots negates insertion and contraction and leaves e unchanged. Thus F7 and step 5.1 are licensed by the full supplied proof, not merely an abstract existence claim.

The original D-to-BSBim arrow could not send the degree-one multiplication dot to a categorical morphism: BSBim admits degree-zero maps only. The target is now explicitly its total graded enrichment. A degree-d map M to N is a degree-zero map M to N(d); after sums/shifts and degree-zero restriction the functor extends to the existing Karoubi category. The generator formulas are unchanged. Elias–Williamson Definition 5.12 and complete Claim 5.13 supply the relation check with Demazure surjectivity over Q; the local dual-basis computation verifies the cup/cap normalization.

The pair-of-words defect sum does not cover arbitrary finite sums and shifts: Hom-total(R direct-sum R,R) has rank two. Retained the word basis and proved the full additive claim using matrix entries, with shift factor v^{r_a-s_b}. The total graded target is now explicit, consistent with the repaired relation lemma. Checked the right-bending inverse using the two triangle identities and left R-linearity, so transferring the diagrammatic basis needs no identification of individual bent leaves.

The cited longest-bimodule definition explicitly supplies the six-term graded decomposition in Remark (b), and its imported-facts Remark (e) supplies the 1-tensor image calculation. Libedinsky equation (21) and section 4.4.2 state precisely the invariant-ring freeness and shifted ranks. Independently, for three variables a,b,c over symmetric polynomials, adjoining a via its monic cubic and b via b^2-(e1-a)b+(e2-a e1+a^2)=0, with c=e1-a-b, gives basis a^i b^j (0<=i<3,0<=j<2) of degrees 0,2,2,4,4,6; adjoining the fixed coordinates preserves this. Thus F4 is mathematically supplied and step 5.1 legitimately compares equal finite-dimensional graded pieces. The truncated contract quotation omits Remark (b), but no mathematical carrier repair is required.
